errors.text: The proposed critical threshold of approximately 450 K conflicts with the observed dominant onset above approximately 673 K.
The hypothesis predicts narrowing of the size distribution, whereas the target reports widening as sub-5 nm particles are progressively lost.
The initial state is described as elliptical and compositionally nonequilibrium rather than the FCC multi-twinned/icosahedral nanoparticles central to the target boundary condition.
